layout_guidance.expansion_allowance: Allow 40 percent longer strings; use wrapping and scrolling rather than smaller critical text.
layout_guidance.speaker_labels: Names are separate runtime controls and can be shown independently.
layout_guidance.timing: Dialogue remains player advanced. Voice length must never force a choice or remove text.
layout_guidance.font_coverage: English source currently uses the bundled runtime fallback. Ship and license required glyph coverage before offering any additional language.
layout_guidance.images: Keep mandatory story text outside raster art.
